body:
Writing copy that sells is hard—especially when you're doing it yourself. This week, we're breaking down the AI writing assistants that small business owners are actually using to save time and boost conversions.

## This Week's Top Picks

**Notion AI**
Turn scattered notes into polished content without leaving your workspace. Best for: Teams already using Notion who want AI built into their workflow. $10/mo (after free tier). [Try Notion AI Free →](https://notion.so/?ref=YOURCODE)

**Copy.ai**
Generate high-converting marketing copy, email sequences, and ad copy in seconds. Best for: Solo founders and agencies cranking out multiple campaigns weekly. Free + $36/mo plans. [Try Copy.ai Free →](https://copy.ai/?ref=YOURCODE)

**Surfer SEO**
Write content that ranks—AI analyzes top-performing pages and tells you exactly what Google wants. Best for: Content creators and marketers who care about organic traffic, not just quick copy. $89/mo. [Try Surfer SEO →](https://surferseo.com/?ref=YOURCODE)

---

## Quick Tip

**Don't just copy-paste AI output.** Use AI as your first draft, then inject your brand voice and specific details in the second pass. The difference between generic and compelling copy is always the human touch—AI saves you 70% of the writing time, but you need to own the last 30%.

---

*See you next week with more tools that actually move the needle for your business.*
